grid.gaps_between_cells: none — cells touch edge to edge

alignment_guides.instruction: The uploaded reference image shows the grid. Black lines (#000000) are cell boundaries. Magenta lines (#FF00FF) are character alignment guides — the character's head must touch the magenta head-line and feet must touch the magenta feet-line in each row. AFTER drawing all characters, DELETE every #FF00FF magenta pixel. Keep characters INSIDE the black #000000 grid cells.

grid_dividers.positions: horizontal at y=256, y=512, y=768 and vertical at x=256, x=512, x=768
grid_dividers.purpose: cell boundaries — no character part may cross these

character_guides.purpose: character height alignment — head touches top guide, feet touch bottom guide
character_guides.removal: delete all #FF00FF magenta pixels from the final image

rows.facing: front-facing — character looks straight toward the viewer
rows.what_viewer_sees: the character's face, chest, and front of body
rows.column_1: idle frame 1 — neutral standing pose, weight centered, arms relaxed at sides
rows.column_2: idle frame 2 — subtle breathing, slight chest rise, gentle sway
rows.column_3: idle frame 3 — slight weight shift to other foot, subtle arm movement
rows.column_4: idle frame 4 — return toward neutral, completing the breathing cycle

rows.facing: back-facing — character faces away from viewer, showing their back
rows.what_viewer_sees: the back of the character's head, back, and rear of body

rows.facing: profile-left — character looks toward 9 o'clock (left edge of image), viewer sees character's RIGHT side
rows.what_viewer_sees: the right side of the character's body in profile
rows.column_1: idle frame 1 — neutral standing in profile

rows.facing: profile-right — character looks toward 3 o'clock (right edge of image), viewer sees character's LEFT side
rows.what_viewer_sees: the left side of the character's body in profile
rows.column_1: idle frame 1 — neutral standing in profile

subject.name: Circe
subject.description: witch-goddess from Greek mythology, adult woman, graceful posture
subject.hair: long dark brown hair past shoulders
subject.outfit: deep violet/purple Greek dress with small gold trim accents
subject.build: graceful feminine figure, not warrior build

style.aesthetic: pixelated retro style, high quality and modern like Stardew Valley — clean readable sprites with flat shading
style.outline: dark 1-pixel outline around the entire character
style.shading: flat cluster shading, no smooth gradients
style.antialiasing: none — crisp pixel edges only, no blur
style.character_height: 70% of cell height (approximately 180 pixels in each 256-pixel cell)
style.character_centering: horizontally centered in each cell, head touching top guide, feet touching bottom guide

rules: this is ONE image containing 16 small characters in a grid — NOT 16 separate images
every character in all 16 cells is the SAME person with the SAME outfit, proportions, and colors
this is the FIRST Circe sheet — it establishes her identity. All future Circe sheets must match this one exactly
no character may cross a cell boundary into a neighboring cell
all heads within a row must align on the row's top guide line
all feet within a row must align on the row's bottom guide line
CRITICAL: the character must be the SAME HEIGHT in ALL 4 rows — Row 4 characters must be exactly as tall as Row 1 characters. Do not shrink or compress any row
identical top-left lighting across all 16 cells
no tilt or rotation on any character
